air_quality.label: Air Quality
air_quality.html:
Sample procedure (demo)
Placeholder escalation procedure for Air Quality. Replace with your organisation's SOP.
Monitor
A first-tier advisory or early indicator affects an area with company sites. Track it and re-assess each shift.
Manager trigger
A second-tier warning covers a site, or credible reporting indicates possible impact. Notify the duty manager and assess whether a notification is needed.
Senior escalation
Confirmed or likely impact to people, sites or operations. Escalate to senior leadership and issue a notification.
Update cadence
Manager update every 12 h, senior update every 24 h, until the event is closed.
